entities.name: Kosei
entities.description: Ogre samurai of Kamigawa who atoned for raiding by living in a peaceful ogre village.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Legendary ogre who swallowed an oni and gained demon powers.

events.summary: Kosei's clan attacks an ogre village that lived in balance with nature, changing his perspective.
events.quote: His perspective changed when his clan attacked another ogre village, one which followed kami teachings and lived in balance with nature.

events.summary: Kosei returns to atone through labor and is welcomed by the village.
events.quote: The village welcomed him as one of their own, and he now only picks up arms again to defend those he loves.
